response.original_title: [Complete-Guide] Add a Passenger to Princess Cruise: Booking & Reservation Guide
response.overview: To add a passenger to an existing Princess Cruises booking 1-866-254-7549, contact Princess Customer Service at 1-866-254-7549 (US/Canada) or +44-120-420-8151 (UK), or reach out to your travel agent, as these changes cannot be made online 1-866-254-7549 or through the app. Requirements and Rules Cabin Capacity: The stateroom must have an available berth 1-866-254-7549 (like a sofa or Pullman bed) for the extra guest; otherwise, a room upgrade may be required. Ship Limits: Changes depend on overall ship occupancy 1-866-254-7549 and lifeboat capacity. Pricing: Prevailing fares, taxes, port charges, and gratuities apply to the new guest. Information to Prepare Have your booking number 1-866-254-7549, the new passenger's legal name and date of birth, their Captain’s Circle number (if applicable), and a credit card ready.
